notes: About 9-10 pages. Sections and stories (no person names): (1) Cover: 'Johannesburg & beyond', four headline numbers (2 stages, 240 SMEs on the ISD platform, 2 FNB entries, 2 continents). (2) Thank-you letter to the Founding Circle (11 backers) and the names page. (3) Connected Africa Summit: Banking Innovator listing in the official programme, the stand earned by building the organiser's events app. (4) DiBETSA: the ISD membership platform shown live, the partner's background and One Million Lightbulbs programme, why the pairing matters. (5) The numbers: ISD members, active rate, membership numbers issued, applications and members by province (data from the live admin dashboard, 9 Nov 2026, 18:46 SAST); next step is bank partnerships. (6) FNB App of the Year 2026: VarsityOS and AdminOS entries; the problems AdminOS solves; 'a product in production' proof numbers; hackathon panel feedback. (7) The poet in the work: Stories of Us, an Eastern Cape storytelling anthology in partnership with the National Arts Council. (8) Beyond Johannesburg: Green Diaspora Forum in Belize (event partner) and the ICSA events platform in build. (9) What your support started: five next steps. (10) The season in numbers and closing thanks. Pairs with app-isd-*, app-adminos-*, app-greendiaspora-* screens.
